description: An international shipping company uses large and small ships to transport containers around the world. A large ship can carry 500 containers while a small ship can carry 200 containers. Because most ports are small, the number of large ships cannot exceed the number of small ships. If the company is under contract needs to transport at least 3000 containers, find the minimum number of ships that can be used.

LargeShipCapacity.definition: Number of containers a large ship can carry

SmallShipCapacity.definition: Number of containers a small ship can carry

RequiredContainers.definition: Minimum number of containers to transport

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of ships (large and small combined) used to transport at least the required number of containers"

constraints.description: The total number of containers transported by large and small ships must be at least RequiredContainers
The number of large ships used cannot exceed the number of small ships used
The numbers of large ships used and small ships used must be non-negative integers
